page.layout: One printed page, one text column. Running head top centre, page number top right. Below the running head: continuation text, then a rule, then an italic preface paragraph, the dispute heading, the respondent line, section "I.", and the body paragraph with a woodcut initial. Catchword bottom right. No marginal notes.

main_text.l: Ad l. 2. Cod. leg Cornel. D

page.notes: The woodcut initial "C" of "Constitutio" is joined to the word. The word "ind l." is set in italic and the "d" is uncertain; it may be "in l.". The respondent line and the section number "I." are printed as paragraphs, not headings. Faint marks in the lower right corner are a digitiser's watermark and are not transcribed.
